instructions: Snap the tough ends off the asparagus where they bend, then cut the spears into 1-inch pieces. Chop the garlic. Beat the eggs in a bowl with 1/4 tsp of the salt.
Heat 4 tbsp of the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the asparagus and cook for 2 minutes, stirring.
Add the garlic, smoked paprika, vinegar and 1/4 tsp of the salt. Stir, cover, and cook for 3 minutes, until the asparagus is bright green and a fork slides in easily.
Take the lid off and pour in the eggs. Stir often for 2 to 3 minutes, until they're nearly set but still creamy.
Take the pan off the heat before the eggs brown. They'll finish cooking from the heat of the pan.
Taste it. If it's flat, add a pinch of the last 1/4 tsp salt. Drizzle with the last 1 tbsp olive oil and add the pepper.
method_notes: Both sources sauté asparagus in olive oil and stir in beaten eggs at the end, keeping them creamy. Fresh-Pressed Olive Oil Club adds garlic, smoked paprika and a splash of vinegar and takes about 8 minutes, which is followed here. Sumptuous Spoonfuls adds chorizo, onion, peppers and toasted bread cubes, which are left out to stay close to the simpler version.
